source: OPIDIN annual maximum water levels (cm above separate local gauge scales)
site_note: Gauge series date from 1955 at Akka and 1931 at Diré according to https://opidin.org/en/background/technical-background-opidin . Earlier chart values can be reconstructed. The API does not identify which individual entries were observed or estimated. The post-2018 Akka annual values have unverified origin; see https://sahelrainindex.info/methods-data/ and https://doi.org/10.1080/10106049.2024.2311203.
